name: Ferrofluid Ocean
description: Ocean-portion-scale ferrofluid surface: Rosensweig spike lattice over Gerstner swell, lit by a mirror-reflects-procedural-sky aurora (D-126 / D-127). The spikes heave on a grid-anchored four-beat pulse, sized by how loud the passage is; the swell beneath them drifts slowly with arousal; the aurora takes its hue from the vocal line, its intensity from the drums stem, and its slow orbit from accumulated audio time paced by arousal. Routing primitives are declared in `audio_routes` below and explained layer-by-layer in the FerrofluidOcean.metal header — this field describes the LOOK and is deliberately NOT a second routing table. It was one until BUG-138: it went on naming a bass_energy_dev → spike-height route for three months after D-153 removed it, plus the accumulated_audio_time × arousal drift product BUG-047 removed and the raw vocals_pitch_hz palette read D-158 replaced — while `audio_routes`, the gated half of this file, stayed correct throughout. Describe behaviour here; let the declarations carry the field names.
